description: A contemporary retelling where a grieving leader’s sleek castle is also a corporate headquarters, cruelty hides behind polished smiles, and Kari’s escape unfolds through modern status games—press, public announcements, and a website proclamation—while the old wonder remains: a talking blue-gray ox, metallic forests, and three Sunday transformations that expose the truth.
tone: Contemporary fairytale, lyrical, tense, ultimately hopeful
summary: Banished by her stepfamily, Kari flees with a talking ox and returns in secret splendor to claim her life back.
